name: my-skills
description: Brainstorm durable specs, implement with TDD and independent review, and debug from evidence to verified fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Brainstorm, implement, and debug with evidence.
interface.longDescription: My Skills provides three shared workflows: clarify ideas into reusable specs, implement specs with test-driven development and independent review, and diagnose bugs through reproduction, root-cause evidence, and verified fixes.
defaultPrompt: Use $brainstorm to turn this idea into an implementation-ready spec.
Use $implement to build the work described by this spec.
Use $debug to reproduce and fix this unexpected behavior.
